title: Swiss Franc weakens as US Dollar rises on hawkish Fed sentiment
summary: USD/CHF gains ground after four days of losses, trading around 0.8220 during Asian hours on Wednesday. The currency pair appreciates as the US Dollar (USD) gains ground on the back of a hawkish policy outlook from the Federal Reserve (Fed).

title: India's HSBC Manufacturing PMI climbs to 55.7 in September
summary: The preliminary reading of India’s HSBC Manufacturing Purchasing Managers Index (PMI) jumped to 55.7 in September versus 52.8 prior, the latest data published by S&P Global and HSBC Bank showed on Wednesday.

title: EUR/USD Price Forecast: Hits fresh low since July 29, around 1.1425 as USD stays firm
summary: The EUR/USD pair remains under some selling pressure for the third straight day, touching a fresh low since July 29, around the 1.1425 region, during the Asian session on Wednesday.
